summary: Citadel is a modular groupware suite designed to handle email, calendars, address books, and collaborative spaces like forums and wikis on your own infrastructure. It bundles multiple communication and information-sharing tools into a single integrated server package. It is implemented using C, Docker, and shell scripts.
goodFor: Self-hosters looking for an all-in-one collaborative workspace suite rather than maintaining separate standalone applications for email, calendars, and messaging.
watchOut: The project lacks recent tagged releases and verifiable activity metrics, meaning you should carefully evaluate its long-term stability and security maintenance before committing critical data.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your stored data and place a reverse proxy in front of the container to handle TLS termination.
